channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Travis Schlenk | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Travis Schlenk from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Winger on Travis Schlenk
item.description:
Said Winger:

“I think it’s probably unorthodox in so far as Will and I are going to collaborate on every meaningful roster decision, every meaningful top-level executive decision, but there shouldn’t be a mistake: Will is running basketball operations for the Wizards. And whatever that day-to-day management requires, whatever decisions that requires, those are Will’s decisions to make. Corporate decisions, higher-level player personnel decisions, I’m certainly going to be involved. There’s gonna be a team of us involved. Coach (John) Thompson (III) is involved. Travis is involved. Wes (Unseld Jr.) will be involved. … We’re going to be a very collaborative group.”

Michael Winger on Travis Schlenk, Jun 9, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Will Dawkins on Travis Schlenk, Michael Winger
item.description:
“It’s a true strength of ours to be from different backgrounds, different markets, shared experiences. Michael and I obviously worked together in Oklahoma City, and we were able to talk through different strategies there as well, and come out connected. I will say that Travis’ experiences in Golden State and Atlanta, we’ll be able to heavily rely on those. Michael, in a big city, star players, heavily rely on those. And, in Oklahoma City, we kind of had two mountains. … we’ve all had a lot of shared experiences at high levels. And, once you put all that in a room, it’s gonna be a little janky for a little bit. But we’ll figure it out.”

Will Dawkins on Travis Schlenk, Michael Winger, Jun 9, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Travis Schlenk, Antony Ressler
item.description:
Kevin Chouinard:Nate McMillan, on today's Travis Schlenk news:

“I have a great deal of respect for Travis. A decision was made between he and Tony (Ressler).Tony addressed the team this morning. Really nothing changes for me, in the sense of where our goals and expectations are for this team.”

Nate McMillan on Travis Schlenk, Antony Ressler, Dec 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Landry Fields, Travis Schlenk
item.description:
“Between Travis, Landry and Nate, we have a hell of a team in our front office and coaching staff,”

Antony Ressler on Landry Fields, Travis Schlenk, May 6, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Travis Schlenk
item.description:
“I have enormous confidence in both Travis and Nate. I think I, as owner, Travis, the president of basketball operations, Nate, as head coach, all underperformed this year. I think if you asked any one of us — hopefully all of us — we would all agree that we all underperformed. We all thought we would be better, and we intend to be better. But if the question is do I have great confidence in their ability, the answer is yes.”

Antony Ressler on Travis Schlenk, May 6, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Travis Schlenk
item.description:
Teague planted the seed for the idea the second time the Hawks acquired him via trade in January 2020.

“When I was there for my second tenure with the Hawks, I told Travis (Schlenk) that I wanted to look into working in the front office,”

Jeff Teague on Travis Schlenk, Mar 9, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kevin Huerter on Travis Schlenk
item.description:
Kevin Huerter on negotiations for a potential extension:

“We're still working. It's something we've kind of worked through throughout the summer. Mostly I let my agent and Travis handle (it). Obviously I hope to get something done but there's no guarantees.”

Kevin Huerter on Travis Schlenk, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Travis Schlenk
item.description:
“I would like to thank Tony, Jami and Travis for putting their faith in me and giving me the opportunity to serve as head coach. I am truly blessed to be able to lead this special group into the future,”

Nate McMillan on Travis Schlenk, Jul 8, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Travis Schlenk, John Collins
item.description:
Hawks owner Tony Ressler said.

“John’s a really good young player and a really good kid. I hope we can figure out a very fair and reasonable contract for him. I know Travis is very focused on keeping John Collins with the Atlanta Hawks.”

Antony Ressler on Travis Schlenk, John Collins, Dec 16, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Travis Schlenk, Lloyd Pierce
item.description:
“And (second-year coach Lloyd Pierce) feels it, (general manager Travis Schlenk) feels it and I feel it. And by the way, if that means all of us feel pressure, that’s what we signed up for.”

Antony Ressler on Travis Schlenk, Lloyd Pierce, Oct 27, 2019. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Lloyd Pierce on Travis Schlenk
item.description:
“I have great respect for Travis and strong belief in his plan to bring a championship to the city of Atlanta. After spending time with ownership, it’s clear they have a deep investment in and commitment to making this a model organization. This opportunity is a perfect fit for me, and I’m eager to get started.”

Lloyd Pierce on Travis Schlenk, May 11, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jerry West on Travis Schlenk
item.description:
Yet while it has been reported that West is pushing for his former Memphis colleague, Grizzlies general manager Chris Wallace,he said the only candidate he's endorsing is Golden State assistant general manager Travis Schlenk.

“I think with Travis, I see a lot of people get jobs, but this guy is eminently qualified,”

Jerry West on Travis Schlenk, Jun 3, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.
